meetings.title: Northwind onboarding sync
meetings.summary: Artem, Julian and Sarah Chen (Northwind) agreed how to cover Northwind's Black Friday peak of about 120 requests per second with three API keys. Webhook retries ship by 14 November and a CSV export of events by 28 November. If the export is late, Northwind gets 10 % off the December invoice.
decisions: Northwind gets three API keys, 50 requests per second each, for the Black Friday peak.
If the CSV export is late, Northwind gets 10 % off the December invoice.

action_items.text: Deliver the CSV export of events for Northwind's finance team

utterances.speaker: Sarah Chen
utterances.text: Our Black Friday peak is about 120 requests per second.

utterances.speaker: Julian
utterances.text: Standard limit is 50 per second per key, so we'll give you three API keys for the peak.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Chen
utterances.text: We lost events last month, we need webhook retries.

utterances.speaker: Julian
utterances.text: Retries with backoff ship by 14 November.

utterances.speaker: Artem
utterances.text: We'll add a CSV export of events for your finance team by 28 November.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Chen
utterances.text: If the export slips we'd like 10 % off the December invoice.

utterances.speaker: Artem
utterances.text: Agreed, 10 % off December if it's late.

facts.speaker: Julian
facts.text: Northwind gets 3 API keys at 50 requests per second each for the Black Friday peak (about 120 rps), agreed on the 10 October call.

facts.speaker: Julian
facts.text: Webhook retries with backoff ship by 14 November (owner: Julian), promised to Northwind on the 10 October call.

facts.speaker: Artem
facts.text: CSV export of events for Northwind is due by 28 November (owner: Artem), promised on the 10 October call.

facts.speaker: Artem
facts.text: On the 10 October call Artem agreed that Northwind gets 10 % off the December invoice if the CSV export is late (after 28 November).

meetings.title: Weekly sync
meetings.summary: Weekly team sync. The rate limit stays at 50 rps until the review, and the billing design is final, so the iOS build starts next week.
decisions: The rate limit stays at 50 rps until the review.
The billing design is final; the iOS build starts next week.
